01-getting-started/01-welcome.md: SA Mod Manager is a desktop app for managing GTA San Andreas mods that run through Mod Loader. It lists your mods, lets you group them into profiles and edits their config files, without digging through folders. Where to go next New here? Read Installing the app first. Adding a mod? See Installing a mod. Something broke? Start with Mod does not load. Use the search box at the top of this window. It searches titles, tags, headings and the full text of every page. Type tag:install to list every page with that tag.
01-getting-started/02-installing-the-app: Installer or portable Version Updates Best for Installer Download and restart from the update button Most people Portable Swap the new build in by hand USB sticks, locked-down PCs Choose your GTA folder Click Scan GTA folder . Pick the folder that contains gta sa.exe . Wait for the mod list to appear. Keep a backup of your game folder before you change anything the first time.
02-mod-list/01-profiles.md: A profile is a named set of enabled mods. Make current writes Profile = into modloader.ini . Create a profile Open the three-dot menu next to the profile drop-down and choose New profile… . Parents A profile can inherit from parents. See Installing a mod for how new mods are enabled in the current profile.
03-installing-mods/01-installing-a-mod.m: Steps Click Install mod and choose the archive, or drop it on the window. Review the plan the installer shows. Confirm. The mod appears in the list. Password-protected archives ask for the password first. Mods that replace game files directly are not handled by Mod Loader. Check the mod's readme. See also Profiles and Mod does not load.
04-config-editor/01-editing-ini-files.md: Form and raw views The form shows each key with a control. Switch to raw text when you need full control. [Settings] EnableFeature = 1 Press Ctrl + F to search inside the file.
Check in this order The mod is enabled in the current profile. modloader.log shows no error for that mod. Open it from Logs . Required ASI plugins are present. Run the version and essentials checker. Still stuck? Export the mod list and attach it when you ask for help.
